build_VCN_model: build a VCN model with configurable max displacement and squeeze factor for coarse-to-fine warping
run_VCN_forward: run the VCN forward pass on image pairs to compute optical flow and depth change
create_flow_reg_module: create a flow_reg module that performs soft winner-take-all displacement selection with entropy output
test_WarpModule: test the WarpModule to warp an image tensor back according to optical flow
review_cost_matching: review the VCN cost_matching method for multi-level feature correlation and hypothesis fusion
